about: Pending work of esv::camp::AvatarContainerSystem on an avatar container (camp chest of a dismissed avatar): a transform to place the container at, two flags, and the set of avatar entities that were dismissed into it. ProcessDismissAvatarRequests (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x9FAD70) inserts the handles of newly dismissed avatars into the set at +0x30; esv::transform::GameplayTransformRequestSystem::Update (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x2A6CA0) copies +0..+0x27 into a 40-byte transform request when both flags are set. Created by bg3.exe+0x2BF04D0 (AllocRaw 0x60, all zero); move-constructed by bg3.exe+0x26F7FF0. Saved model game.camp.v0.AvatarContainerRequestsComponent is 1 byte (nothing of substance saved). Never seen alive. Registry total 96 (server row).

evidence.says: Toolkit GameplayTransformRequestSystem::Update iterates this component (stride 0x60) and copies its first five qwords (+0..+0x27) into a 0x28-stride transform request entry (five 8-byte copies, qword 0..4 of the component to qword 0..4 of the entry) - the 40 bytes of an ls::Transform (rotation quat, translate, scale; SE Transform). bg3.exe move-constructor bg3.exe+0x26F7FF0 copies +0..+0x2F as plain data; creator zeroes it. Windows confirmed: per-frame update of esv::transform::GameplayTransformRequestSystem bg3.exe+0x41E84E0 (lines 225-239) walks the components with stride 0x60 and copies qwords 0..4 (+0..+0x27) into a 0x28-stride transform value.

Toolkit GameplayTransformRequestSystem::Update requires the byte at +0x28 of the component to be non-zero (and the one at +0x2C) before using the transform; bg3.exe move-constructor copies the dword at +0x28; creator zeroes it. Windows: bg3.exe+0x41E84E0 tests that the byte at +0x28 is non-zero (reached as the sixth qword slot of the component) together with +0x2C.

Toolkit requires the byte at +0x2C of the component to be non-zero together with +0x28; bg3.exe move-constructor copies the dword at +0x2C. Windows: bg3.exe+0x41E84E0 tests the byte at +0x2C; bg3.exe+0x2BEEB50 clears it (byte 0) and bg3.exe+0x2BEF600 sets it to 1.

Creator bg3.exe+0x2BF04D0 zeroes +0x30..+0x5F in the HashSet pattern (buckets +0x30, next ids +0x40 with count +0x4C, keys +0x50 with count +0x5C); move-constructor bg3.exe+0x26F7FF0 moves pointer/size pairs at +0x30, +0x40, +0x50 and clears the source. Toolkit ProcessDismissAvatarRequests: for each entity that just got eoc::user::DismissedComponent it calls EoCServer.dll+0x257C60 with the set at +0x30 of the component and the entity (hash-set insert of an 8-byte handle). Windows: bg3.exe+0x2BEF3C0 (called from the AvatarContainerSystem update bg3.exe+0x238E280) inserts the entity handles of a query into +0x30 with bg3.exe+0x721030, the HashSet<uint64-like> insert (key compared as one 8-byte value, hash = key % buckets, keys at +0x20 of the set with stride 8); bg3.exe+0x2BEEB50 clears it with bg3.exe+0x5C4330.
